summary: Shuei Kato, 39, of Summit County, lost for three days on Missouri Mountain (his 15th fourteener): departed the trailhead early Saturday 2017-10-07, summited, then descended the opposite side into a different valley; reported overdue Saturday by his wife Valerie; 45+ ground searchers and 3 helicopters (CCSAR North/South, Summit and Lake county SAR, Flight for Life, REACH, Air National Guard, HAATS) searched as weather deteriorated; found alive Tuesday ~5 mi from the summit at his campfire after aircraft picked up the heat signature; walked out uninjured
responding_agency: Chaffee County SAR North/South; Summit County Rescue Group; Lake County SAR; Flight for Life; REACH Air Ambulance; Colorado Air National Guard; HAATS
notes: DATE PIN NOTE: date = found/search-conclusion date per convention; pinned from the article's "reported Saturday, found Tuesday" narrative plus the article-creation timestamp 2017-10-11; 2017-10-07 was Saturday, 2017-10-10 Tuesday. Inserted run 548 (Mountain Mail rotation chunk).
